اختصروا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَصَرُوا (iḵtaṣarū) /ix.ta.sˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# اُخْتُصِرُوا (uḵtuṣirū) /ux.tu.sˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# اِخْتَصِرُوا (iḵtaṣirū) /ix.ta.sˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
